name: badge
title: Badge
description: A compact status label that stays still while the content around it animates.
docs:
## When to use - A short status: `Active`, `Beta`, `Deprecated`, `3 open`. - A category or tag next to a title, where the colour carries the grouping. - A count attached to a navigation item or a filter chip. ## When not to use - Anything the user must click to act; use `button` (a badge has no focus, no press feedback, and no keyboard path). - More than about three words. A long label belongs in running text or in a `card` header, not in a pill. - A status that changes while the user watches; use `toast` or an inline message, because a badge swap is easy to miss. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/badge ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { Badge } from "@/components/cadence/badge/badge"; export function Release() { return (
Parity plan 0.2.0
); } ``` ## Examples ### Variants ```tsx Default Secondary Outline Ghost Failed Changelog ``` ### With an icon ```tsx import { Check } from "lucide-react"; Verified ; ``` ### As a link `render` replaces the element, so a badge stays a `span` unless you ask for something else. The `[a&]` selectors only switch on hover when it really is a link. ```tsx }> 3 releases ``` ## API | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------ | | `variant` | `"default" \| "secondary" \| "outline" \| "ghost" \| "destructive" \| "link"` | `"default"` | Visual weight. | | `render` | `ReactElement \| (props, state) => ReactElement` | – | Base UI composition; replaces `asChild`. | | `className` | `string` | – | Merged last. | `data-slot="badge"` and `data-variant` are rendered from the component's state, so you can restyle per variant from CSS without touching this file. All native span props are forwarded. ## Motion contract No motion (T0). A badge labels content; it does not enter, leave, or move. | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | ------- | ----------------------------------- | ----- | ------------- | | – | none | – | – | | reduced | none | – | – | | none | none | – | – | `transition-[color,box-shadow]` is state feedback on the design tokens (hover on a linked badge, the focus ring), not motion: it never moves the box and never runs on mount. ## Accessibility - The badge is a `span`, so it is not in the tab order and has no role — the text itself is the message. - Colour is never the only signal: every variant still carries readable text. - When rendered as a link it inherits the anchor's semantics, focus ring, and keyboard behaviour, and gains `[a&]:hover` styles automatically. ## Notes for AI - Never attach `onClick` to a badge; switch to `button` with `size="sm"`. - Do not animate a badge in or out. If the status changes, swap the text and let `aria-live` on the surrounding region announce it.
